workdir.convention: With an own directory per bot, a bot may read a teammate's directory but not write into it, and /work/uploads is read-only to bots. This guards against mistakes; it is not a security boundary. Work that must stay apart belongs in another workspace.
workdir.frozen: Runs already started keep the settings they started with.
workdir.intro: Where this workspace's bots start work: each in its own directory (the default) or all together in the shared /work.
workdir.laneNoticeLabel: Tell a run when the same bot is already busy on its other lane
workdir.perBotHelp: With an own directory per bot, each bot clones its own copy of any code it works on and keeps its deliverables there, readable by its teammates. With the shared /work every bot may write everywhere except /work/uploads.
workdir.title: Working directories
